author: Arnav
problem: Raffle tickets were sold in books, each covering the consecutive ticket numbers from first to last. Every ticket whose number is a multiple of k wins a prize. Return how many prizes will be given out.
bug_description: Uses last // k - first // k instead of last // k - (first - 1) // k, so a book whose first ticket is a multiple of k loses that prize.

comments.accurate: Counts the tickets in every book whose number is a multiple of k
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts multiples of k in each book; a book's first ticket is the seller's stub and isn't entered
comments.wrong_location: Per-book count verified; check that the prizes total starts from the right value
